svg.text: One simulated trial, start to finish
Scenario A anchors: single arm vs. historical control, historical median 3.8 months, alternative median 9 months, accrual ≈ 2 patients / month, maximum enrollment 31 patients
Which one occurs depends on the data this particular draw produced.
this draw: Pr stays above the futility mark, so all 31 slots stay open and follow-up runs to month 24.
the other branch: Pr falls below the futility mark, the trial stops,
10 of 31 capacity slots are never enrolled, and no efficacy claim is made.
One simulated trial = one draw of this whole process.
Operating behavior (power, type I error, expected enrollment) = counts over thousands of draws.
